verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say each cloud session gets its own VM with a shell, browser, and full repo access, and keeps working after you close your laptop. You can hand tasks off from local work, run independent tasks in parallel, and have sessions boot into a preconfigured environment. Community reports corroborate long-running background sessions (working for days, checked every 10-15 minutes, with a configurable max work time). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the cloud VM's isolation and security boundaries (the documented OS-level sandbox covers only the local CLI).
